description: Vulnerability in the Oracle AutoVue product of Oracle Supply Chain (component: Security).   The supported version that is affected is 21.1.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle AutoVue.  Successful attacks require human interaction from a person other than the attacker. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of Oracle AutoVue accessible data as well as  unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle AutoVue accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.4 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N).
